title: feat(studio): switch a read-only package's flow off for this deployment from the Automations pillar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu85pY93xKTmJgLfTt1CGoVP)_

Fixes #28148

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 自动化里打开一个只读软件包（如 HotCRM）的流程时，头部的开关改为「本部署开关」：读写部署的启用账本（`_status` / `toggle`），文案为「本部署中已开启 / 本部署中已关闭 / 本部署中已开启，但未在此运行」，与 Setup › 打包自动化同一套三种读法；可写软件包的流程仍是原来的定义开关和删除。Setup 页的开关请求挪进共用模块，两处发同一个请求。Clone 不在本 PR（归 #28149）。
- **为什么改**：以前只读流程头部的锁定开关读的是定义，旁边的状态读的是账本，会出现「状态: 已停用」旁边写「🔒 已启用」；管理员也无法就地关掉打包流程，只能去 Setup 找（ADR-0146 D4，裁决「28148 暂停解除」）。
- **风险与回滚**：只动前端；服务端仍是唯一裁判，在 group / isolated 姿态下非平台管理员看到禁用开关和一句原因，真拒绝时原样显示服务端的话。新增 `engine.studio.auto.ledger.*` 文案键（en、zh），属 Clause-② widening。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（`ledgerRow`、`toggleLedger`、`flowSwitchEl`）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/FlowLedgerSwitch.tsx`；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/packagedFlowLedger.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：showcase 里进 Studio → 只读软件包 → 自动化，打开 `showcase_urgent_task_alert`，点头部开关；预期文案在「本部署中已开启 / 已关闭」之间切换、网络面板只有一次 `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_urgent_task_alert/toggle`，旁边的状态随之一致；可写软件包的流程仍显示「已启用 / 已停用」。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The ledger switch on the item** (`FlowLedgerSwitch.tsx`, new). On a read-only package's open flow, when `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` serves a row for it, the Automations pillar's header switch binds the ADR-0126 §7.2 activation ledger instead of the definition: `aria-checked` is the row's `enabled`, and a click sends `POST /api/v1/automation/NAME/toggle` at once (no draft is written). Its word is `activationReading` (`views/setup/packagedFlows.ts`) for the same row, the reading Setup › Packaged automation shows: "On for this deployment", "On for this deployment, not running here" (muted track, the platform's `reason` as sent, described on the switch and in its title, never parsed), "Off for this deployment". A writable package's flow keeps its definition switch and its Delete, unchanged. Two switches, two words.
- **Posture-aware, refusal verbatim.** `useFlowLedgerWalledReadOnly` (`views/setup/packagedFlowLedger.ts`) pre-judges the toggle gate (`activation-gate.ts#refuseUngrantedActivationWrite`) from the two served facts, `features.tenancyPosture` via `useTenancyPosture()` and `user.isPlatformAdmin`, the posture-and-rung half of `walledCatalogReadOnly` without its catalog-type filter (director note 6526396053; ⛔ not that function, which answers `false` for a flow). Under `group` / `isolated` a non-operator gets the switch disabled with the console's own sentence; after any attempt the server's refusal is shown verbatim in the pillar's refusal strip.
- **One toggle request.** `requestFlowToggle` moved out of `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` into `packagedFlowLedger.ts`; both surfaces call it with their own fallback words. Setup's clone request stays on Setup's page, untouched.
- **The rail keeps `unboundCause`.** `flowRailState` now keeps the `_status` row's `unboundCause` (non-empty string only) beside `reason`, so `activationReading` reads it for presence. The rail, the header status and the Problems panel read exactly as before.
- **i18n.** A contiguous block of `engine.studio.auto.ledger.*` keys in the studio namespace (en, zh). This is the widening behind `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- **Resumed work.** The branch merges the unreviewed WIP `claude/project-thread-dhj1ou@1a9e7703` (release 6541889272) and then drops its Clone half per ruling 6542841890: `FlowCloneDialog.tsx`, the Clone menu entry, the shared clone request and the `engine.studio.auto.clone.*` keys are gone; `FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx` and the Delete test are byte-identical to `main`.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.ledgerSwitch-28148.test.tsx`, 8 cases, the metadata server doubled at the client and the `/automation` doors doubled at `fetch`:

- the switch reads the ledger, not the definition: definition `obsolete` + ledger on reads on; a flip posts `{ enabled: false }`, re-reads `_status`, saves no draft, toasts;
- the measured disagreement (definition `active`, ledger off) reads "Off for this deployment", one switch only, no read-only hint;
- an enabled flow with an `unboundCause` reads "not running here" with the platform's sentence, wired into `aria-describedby`;
- `group` posture, non-operator: disabled, the console's sentence, nothing sent; CONTROLS `single` and `isolated` + operator: live;
- a 403 refusal is shown verbatim and the switch keeps the ledger's reading;
- CONTROL: a writable package's flow keeps its definition switch and Delete, and its switch never reaches the ledger door.

All readings below are on head `b328333c86` (this branch after its one merge of `origin/main` at `3fb1a24540`), the dependency closure rebuilt first (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 64/64).

<details><summary>Tests and type-check</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` (both run `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the tests are compiled): lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/ packages/i18n/`: Test Files 386 passed (386), Tests 3573 passed, 13 skipped (3586).
- The new file alone, verbose: Tests 8 passed (8).
- eslint on the seven changed source files: 0 errors; the 22 warnings are all on lines this diff does not touch.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Run on the committed head before the main merge (`6d9de7534a`; the merge touched none of these files). Each mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0) and the ledger test file went red:

- A1 `checked={ledgerRow.enabled}` to `checked={flowEnabled}` (bind the definition): 4 failed (ledger binding, measured disagreement, not running, refusal).
- A2 `reading={activationReading(ledgerRow)}` to a two-way on/off: 1 failed (not running here).
- A3 `flowLedgerWalledReadOnly` returns `false`: 1 failed (walled non-operator).
- A4 the toggle refusal uses the fallback instead of `actionErrorDetail`: 1 failed (refusal verbatim).
- A5 the ledger row no longer requires `readOnly`: 1 failed (writable package CONTROL). The first A5 attempt was a no-op the tool refused (its replacement was a substring of its anchor, so the count did not rise); re-run with a distinct replacement.

</details>


## Acceptance notes

- When `_status` serves no row for the open flow (an older backend, or a flow the engine never registered), there is no ledger flag to bind, so the read-only definition switch stays as it was, with its lock and the read-only package hint. Card item 3 removes that hint where the ledger switch is drawn, which is every case with a row.
- The PR body's attribution line links this card thread's project thread, as the harness requires; the seat order names the seat thread instead. Noted, not corrected.
- Branch name is the platform-assigned card-thread branch `claude/project-thread-krgxy0`, the recorded exception to `claude/issue-N-slug` (claim 6542901778).
